ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what does the conoesucidae get its energy from?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram there are two similar parts, with "Conoesucidae (caddisfly)" labeled at the lower right. Near it below there is a pile of debris/organic detritus labeled "detritus", and there is an arrow pointing from "detritus" to "Conoesucidae". Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate that energy flows from the food source to the organism obtaining energy. Therefore, Conoesucidae obtains energy from detritus.
